name: Ring of Ethereal Touch
body:
Aura strong transmutation; CL 13th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ghost ring. When the ring is worn, however, all non-living material on the wearer’s person, including the ring of ethereal touch, becomes ethereal. The ring becomes inactive while on the Ethereal Plane.

This ring may be destroyed by casting remove curse followed by ghost touch upon it. Items which have become ethereal remain so until the are retrieved from the Ethereal Plane via ethereal jaunt or a similar spell.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ghost ring

Identification DC 38
False Identification DC 28
